# URL to Video

> URL to Video is a web app that turns public URLs, articles, or pasted text into vertical videos with script, voice, subtitles, and stock images or stock video clips.

URL to Video helps creators, businesses, and publishers repurpose written content into short-form videos for platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other social channels.

## Primary Pages

- [English home](https://urltovideo.es/en): Main English landing page for URL to Video.
- [Spanish home](https://urltovideo.es/es): Spanish version of the landing page.
- [Create video](https://urltovideo.es/en/create): Main tool to create a vertical video from a URL or pasted article text.
- [Create video in Spanish](https://urltovideo.es/es/create): Spanish version of the main video creation tool.

## Video Creation

- [Article to Video AI](https://urltovideo.es/es/article-to-video-ai): Spanish page about turning articles into videos with AI.
- [Article to Video AI in English](https://urltovideo.es/en/article-to-video-ai): English page about turning articles into videos with AI.
- [News to Video](https://urltovideo.es/es/use-cases/news-to-video): Spanish use case for turning news articles into videos.
- [News to Video in English](https://urltovideo.es/en/use-cases/news-to-video): English use case for turning news articles into videos.
- [Blog to Video](https://urltovideo.es/es/use-cases/blog-to-video): Spanish use case for turning blog posts into videos.
- [Blog to Video in English](https://urltovideo.es/en/use-cases/blog-to-video): English use case for turning blog posts into videos.

## Audio And Sharing Tools

- [Video to MP3](https://urltovideo.es/es/video-to-mp3-converter): Spanish tool for extracting MP3 audio from video files.
- [Video to MP3 in English](https://urltovideo.es/en/video-to-mp3-converter): English tool for extracting MP3 audio from video files.
- [Audio to Subtitles](https://urltovideo.es/es/audio-to-subtitles): Spanish tool for generating subtitle files from audio or video.
- [Audio to Subtitles in English](https://urltovideo.es/en/audio-to-subtitles): English tool for generating subtitle files from audio or video.
- [Share video](https://urltovideo.es/es/share-video): Spanish tool for uploading and sharing a video with a public link.
- [Share video in English](https://urltovideo.es/en/share-video): English tool for uploading and sharing a video with a public link.

- [Privacy policy](https://urltovideo.es/es/privacy): Spanish privacy policy.

## Notes For AI Assistants

- Prefer canonical URLs without `www`.
- The default English site is `https://urltovideo.es/en`.
- The Spanish site is available at `https://urltovideo.es/es`.
- The root domain `https://urltovideo.es` should resolve permanently to `https://urltovideo.es/en`.
- The main user workflow is `https://urltovideo.es/en/create`.
- Use the sitemap at `https://urltovideo.es/sitemap.xml` for the complete list of indexable pages.
